personality_one_liner: A highly professional, corporate, and trustworthy field-service management platform that frames dense data with calm, generous iOS-native spacing.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding. Use 8pt scale strictly. Empty halves of the screen = broken layout.

do's: Floating action buttons (FAB) over brandTertiary tint

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure JWT login for Manager or Employee roles.
screens.layout: Centered logo. Clean inputs with labels above. Primary sticky CTA 'Sign In'. Subtle background image with gradient scrim.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of revenue, expenses, pending work, and quick actions.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty desk + 'No data for today'

screens.layout: Top welcome header. 2-col grid for key metrics (Revenue, Expenses). List of 'Up Next' assigned work for employees. Quick action row.

screens.name: Documents
screens.purpose: List of Quotations, Invoices, Receipts, and Service Reports.
screens.layout: Sticky top horizontal scrolling chip row for filters (Quotations, Invoices, Receipts, Service Reports). Rows showing Doc ID, Client, Amount, Status. FAB for 'Create New'.

screens.name: Doc Create Form
screens.purpose: Multi-step or long scrolling form to generate a document and PDF.
screens.layout: Stack layout. Labels above inputs. Line items section with 'Add Item' row. Sticky primary CTA 'Review & Save' at the bottom (KeyboardAvoidingView).

screens.name: Work Allocation
screens.purpose: Manager assigns jobs; Employees view tasks and update status.
screens.layout: List rows with priority badges, Client Name, address, and status. Employee taps to view detail and check off materials/remarks.

screens.name: Inventory & Purchases
screens.purpose: Manage items and upload purchase bills.
screens.layout: Search bar at top. List of items with stock levels. FAB for adding stock. Bottom sheet for file upload (Base64).

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: Cover banner image. Avatar fallback initials. Settings rows with tinted icon containers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the exact brand tokens provided: primary Navy (#1B3A5F) and accent Red (#C8102E). This is an explicit exception granted by the prompt for the Banned Blues rule.
Implement bottom tab navigation consisting of Home, Documents, Work, Profile. Use a stack for 'Create' flows triggered by FABs.
For document creation flows (Invoice, Quotation), use a scrolling container with a fixed primary CTA pinned to the bottom root.
Forms should have labels directly above the input fields. Do not use floating labels.
File uploads (purchase bills/expenses) should support taking a photo or uploading a PDF, transforming it into Base64 for the MongoDB backend.
Ensure VAT 5% calculations and auto-sequential numbering (e.g. SE-INV-2026-001) are wired properly in document creation logic.
Role-based views: Manager sees total revenue/expenses on the Dashboard; Employee sees 'Up Next' assigned work.
Apply 'expo-glass-effect' or 'expo-blur' on elevated surfaces like sticky headers and bottom tab bars to maintain an iOS-Native Clean feeling.
Use the logo and server/cctv imagery with a gradient-to-dark scrim layer pattern when text is overlaid on them.
